title: Phytochemical profiling, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory potential of methanolic extracts of Moringa oleifera (L.) Lam. and Moringa stenopetala (Bak.) Cufod. leaves grown in Arba Minch, Ethiopia
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43818-43829
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05914C, Paper

Masresha Ahmed Assaye, Marinella De Leo, Duccio Volterrani, Hagos Tesfay, Frehiwot Teka, Eyob Debebe, Solomon Genet Gebre
Phytochemical profiles, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities were assessed in methanolic extracts of Moringa oleifera (L.) Lam. and Moringa stenopetala (Bak.) Cufod. leaves, using a workflow from plant collection to lab assays.
